description: Implement the optional SPU Validator Unit supporting pattern selected by a concrete Step for validation responsibilities. The validator produces SPUValidatorResult carried independently in result slots. Validation conclusions remain domain results, not automatic invocation failures. Implement Validator Unit Association (validatorUnitAssociationIdentity distinct from participant identities) and Validator Unit Lifecycle contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator Unit validation conclusions are domain results, not invocation failures
SPUValidatorResult carried independently in optional result slot
Validator Unit Association identity distinct from participant identities
Step Composition is sole authority for establishing/changing/ending associations
Association does not transfer association-management authority to target
Validator Unit Lifecycle milestones implemented (provisioned, prepared, ready, admitted, ...)
definitionOfDone: Validator unit tests for validation conclusion semantics
Association identity uniqueness and stability tests
Architecture test: no universal one-validator-per-SPU relationship imposed
testStrategy: Validator unit unit tests; association identity tests; lifecycle milestone tests
